title: lava env --json
description: Every environment variable this app reads, declared or not. The union is the point: app declarations, then packs', then names that exist only in config/.env — that last group is invisible to every other view of the app, and it is exactly what an agent needs when a value 'is definitely set' but never reaches the code. `source` separates a variable the real environment provided from one config/.env promoted, because those two disagree in production.

required.description: Declared required by the app or a pack. A missing required variable is a warn, so `lava check` reports it without failing until --strict.

secret.description: True when this name looked secret and --reveal was not passed, so `value` is null here.

declared_by.description: Who declared it — app/Services.php, or the package name. Null for a bare config/.env entry nothing declares.

set.description: Whether a value was found at all, from either source.

source.description: env = the real process environment (which always wins); dotenv = config/.env supplied it; null = nothing set it.

value.description: The value, or null when it is unset or redacted.

resolved_env.description: The environment boot resolved to — what `LAVA_ENV` and --env decided.

env_file.description: The dotenv file that was read, relative to the app root, or null when there is none.
